notes: Named as the applied active substance at [0154], [0155], [0157] and [0160]. The section states application rates per hectare and per 100 kg of seed, which are use rates and not a charged mass, volume or equivalent, so quantity is null and nothing is converted. Role is other because the compound is applied here rather than made or consumed; finalise.py lets a later section's populated scalar win, so this value can overwrite the reactant role recorded by the experimental sections. The section also mentions fertilizers, active substances of other herbicidal or growth-regulating groups, active substances against animal pests, fungi and bacteria, mineral salts and non-phytotoxic oils and oil concentrates as things a spray fluid may also contain. These are classes with no member named and no defined place in a composition, so no compound record is made for them; they were read and deliberately not emitted.

Same molecule as tembotrione, formula C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity and carries a separate identifier only because the patent names the forms separately. This is form A. Named at [0153], [0154], [0156] and [0157] as the form that is diluted into spray fluids and applied, always as an alternative to form C. No amount is stated for it, so quantity is null. Role is other because it is applied rather than made.

Same molecule as tembotrione, formula C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity and carries a separate identifier only because the patent names the forms separately. This is form C. Named at [0153], [0154], [0156] and [0157] as the alternative to form A. The section prints it only as 'form C' or 'form A or C', never with a definite article of its own, so only 'form C' is carried as a printed alias.
Named at [0153] as the diluent of the formulations, which are made up into aqueous spray fluids. No amount is stated, so quantity is null.
